title: Radiological and histological evaluation of horizontal ridge augmentation using corticocancellous freeze-dried bone allograft with and without autogenous bone: A randomized controlled clinical trial
authors: Hashemipoor M, Asghari N, Mohammadi M, Kalantari M, Arabsolghar M, Ranjbar H. Clin Implant Dent Relat Res. 2020 Oct;22(5):582-592. doi: 10.1111/cid.12935.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Based on the results of this study, corticocancellous FDBA granules along with collagen membrane can successfully be used for horizontal augmentation of edentulous ridge, and adding AB to the granules of FDBA does not significantly increase the quality an d quantity of regenerated bone” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
